title: Gérard Depardieu withdraws his appeal against a sexual assault conviction
dek: The 2025 verdict now stands. A separate rape case against the actor is still moving through French courts.
what: Outlook India, carrying an AFP report, says Gérard Depardieu withdrew on 13 November 2026 his appeal against a May 2025 conviction for sexually assaulting two women on the set of the 2021 film Les Volets Verts. The two women were a set dresser and an assistant director. The sentence was 18 months suspended, with registration as a sex offender. AFP's source was a person close to the case. With the appeal withdrawn, the verdict is final.
Reuters, in a post on X, says he also apologized to his victims. The AFP report I read does not mention an apology, and I could not confirm it outside X. It says he has denied the allegations.

A separate case is open. Actress Charlotte Arnould has filed a rape complaint, which he denies. He has appealed against the decision to send it to a criminal court, and a ruling on that appeal is expected on 26 November.
why: A famous name and a final verdict in a case that became a marker in France's debate over abuse in film.
next: The ruling on 26 November on whether the rape case goes to a criminal court.
